youtube.title: YouTube Chat Overlay
youtube.instructionDesc: For YouTube, integration is done directly via the official live chat URL. Your API quotas are thus preserved and the chat remains perfectly synchronized.
youtube.step1Title: Create a Browser Source in OBS
youtube.step1Desc:
In the "URL" field, paste the standard pop-out chat URL of your YouTube live.
Example: https://www.youtube.com/live_chat?is_popout=1&v=YOUR_VIDEO_ID
youtube.step2Desc: Go to the "Customize" section to adjust colors, fonts, and borders. Then copy the generated "OBS CSS" code and paste it into the "Custom CSS" field of your browser source.
youtube.step3Desc: The chat will instantly become transparent and take on your custom colors.
youtube.cssObsDesc: Copy this code and paste it in the "Custom CSS" field of your YouTube Chat browser source in OBS.
